claims: Green Cards allow foreign nationals to live and work permanently in the U.S.
Green Cards are generally valid for 10 years
Form I-485 is a green card application
Green Card applications cost over $1,000 depending on age
Family-Based Green Cards are for spouses, children, or parents of U.S. citizens or permanent residents
Employment-Based Green Cards are for workers with specific job offers or exceptional abilities
Diversity Visa Lottery is a lottery program for individuals from countries with low immigration rates to the U.S.
Refugee/Asylee Green Cards are for individuals granted refuge or asylum
Form I-693 is a medical examination and vaccination record
A sponsor generally files a petition such as Form I-130 or Form I-140
Form I-485 is for Adjustment of Status
Form I-485 is filed once a visa is available
Form I-485 can be filed inside the U.S. or via consular processing from abroad
The standard Form I-485 filing fee is $1,440
Form I-485 filing fees are lower for children
Most Green Cards are valid for 10 years
Conditional residents receive a Green Card valid for 2 years
Form I-90 is used to replace an expiring or lost Green Card
